description: This file implements a development service for managing agent processes in a software project, including starting, stopping, and monitoring development mode in the agent framework.

classes.name: DefaultDevService
classes.description: Implements the DevService interface, handles starting, stopping, and monitoring development agent processes.

methods.name: RunInDevMode
methods.description: Starts the agent in development mode after verifying agentfield.yaml exists.

methods.name: StopDevMode
methods.description: Placeholder for stopping dev mode, not yet implemented.

methods.name: GetDevStatus
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving dev status, not yet implemented.

methods.name: runDev
methods.description: Handles the core logic of starting the agent process, setting environment, managing signals, and discovering the agent port.

methods.name: getFreePort
methods.description: Finds a free port, either via portManager or by direct checking.

methods.name: isPortAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is available.

methods.name: startDevProcess
methods.description: Starts the agent process with environment variables and virtual environment support.

methods.name: discoverAgentPort
methods.description: Discovers the port on which the agent is running by polling localhost endpoints.

methods.name: waitForAgent
methods.description: (Unused) Waits until the agent responds on the specified port, indicating readiness.

methods.name: displayDevCapabilities
methods.description: Fetches and displays agent capabilities such as reasoners and skills.

methods.name: loadDevEnvFile
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file within the package directory.
